table.retrieve:
SELECT	ReportData.code1,   
			ReportData.value1,   
			ReportData.name1,   
			ReportData.name2,   
			ReportData.name3,   
			ReportData.name4,   
			ReportData.name5,   
			ReportData.name6, 
			ReportData.Code2  
FROM		ReportData   
WHERE		code1 IN (:ai_areacode)
ORDER BY	name1, code1, name3, name2, code2, value1
table.sort: name1 A, name3 A, name2 A, name4 A, name5 A, name6 A

objects.name: compute_20
objects.expression: "Report Date:" + string(today(),  'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss' ) + '       As on: ' + String( ad_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss' )

objects.name: value1_t
objects.text: case(int(number("@code2")) when 0 then 'Current (0)' when 1 then '1-' + trim(string(ai_interval)) when 2 to ai_limit then trim(string(left(string(int(number("@code2"))), 100))) + '-' +  case((int(number("@code2")) + ai_interval - 1) when IS > ai_limit then trim(string(ai_limit)) else trim(string((int(number("@code2")) + ai_interval - 1))) ) ELSE '> ' + trim(string(ai_limit)) ) + '~r~nDays Old'

props.rows: name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, name6
props.sourcenames: code1, value1, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, name6, code2
